verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents connecting payroll and HR systems such as Gusto and Rippling so Ari plans from those records. It also documents modeling hire scenarios ("a hire wave", "what a hire… does") and forecasting costs and cash, which suggests planned hires feed the expense forecast. However, no evidence shows a dedicated headcount plan at the role level, or how payroll actuals reconcile against planned positions. missing for 10: explicit role/position-level headcount planning, documented mapping of payroll actuals to planned roles, detail on how hires flow into expense lines, independent or hands-on corroboration.
